record.one_liner: Cloud observability and security platform for infrastructure metrics, logs, APM traces, monitors, dashboards, and incidents.
record.auth_notes: REST API: API key in DD-API-KEY header, plus an application key in DD-APPLICATION-KEY for endpoints that read data or manage resources. Application keys can be scoped. OAuth2 (authorization code with PKCE) is documented for partner integrations, with the client created in a Partner Sandbox Account. PATs and service account tokens are documented as bearer tokens for the MCP server; I did not confirm they work on the REST API.
record.access_notes: Keys are created in any org by users with the right permissions. A 14-day trial (no card, per search snippet of Datadog's trial page, which I did not fetch directly) and a Free tier (Infrastructure Monitoring only, up to 5 Basic hosts, 1-day retention) exist. I could not verify that the Free tier includes API access, so the classification is uncertain: it could be self_serve_free for limited use. Third-party OAuth needs a Partner Sandbox Account; the partner program terms were not described on the page I fetched.
record.blocker: Users need a Datadog org (the free tier is limited to Infra Monitoring, 5 hosts). Per-site regional endpoints are required. Third-party OAuth is tied to the partner sandbox/integration program. Rate limits were not confirmed. Unscoped application keys inherit the creator's full permissions.

evidence.auth: https://docs.datadoghq.com/developers/authorization/oauth2_in_datadog/ (OAuth2 auth code + PKCE for partner integrations); https://docs.datadoghq.com/account_management/api-app-keys/ (API keys, scoped application keys); https://docs.datadoghq.com/api/latest/ (DD-API-KEY / DD-APPLICATION-KEY headers)
evidence.access: https://www.datadoghq.com/pricing/ (Free tier: Infrastructure Monitoring, up to 5 Basic hosts; API access on free tier not stated)
evidence.api: https://docs.datadoghq.com/api/latest/ (REST, v1 and v2, many resources, official client libraries)
evidence.mcp: https://docs.datadoghq.com/mcp_server/setup.md (official endpoints per site, OAuth 2.0, PAT/SAT, API+app keys; US1-FED/US2-FED unsupported)
